items.source: /// Total length of every string in a JSON value.

items.name: text_length
items.source:
fn text_length(value: &Value) -> u64 {
    match value {
        Value::String(text) => text.len() as u64,
        Value::Array(items) => items
            .iter()
            .map(text_length)
            .fold(0u64, u64::saturating_add),
        Value::Object(fields) => fields
            .values()
            .map(text_length)
            .fold(0u64, u64::saturating_add),
        _ => 0,
    }
}
